opening.argument: The presentation offers an easy Uniswap bot method for passive income, then directs viewers to connect MetaMask to Ethereum, deploy a contract, pay gas fees, and supply ether to operate it. The speaker says, "And the more profit you'll be able to accumulate over time," tying greater funding to greater accumulated profit, and reports "Something close to 40% which isn't that bad?" as a claimed return. It also describes a bot "sniffing the mempool" and profiting by sandwiching another user's transaction. Although profitability is said to fluctuate and is not always achieved, the records do not verify that the code or reported returns are reproducible. Taken together, these are hallmarks of a high-return trading-bot or funded-contract offer.

citations.quote: In this youtube video tutorial I will be explaining to you an easy method to make passive income using Uniswap.
So to start off you will need to have Metamask installed and connected to the ethereum mainnet.
And the more profit you'll be able to accumulate over time
Something close to 40% which isn't that bad?
The start button will start the bot, sniffing the mempool.
